description: Metric definitions come from the metric catalog: root -> member -> the models that carry it. Scores root_id, member_id and an accepted model.

cases.name: gmv_definition
cases.query: What's the definition of GMV, and which model carries it? Reply with a single JSON object only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text. Required shape: {"root_id": "<metric catalog root_id or null>", "member_id": "<member_id or null>", "model": "<the dbt model that best carries this metric, or null>", "definition": "<one sentence>"}
cases.notes: Default GMV excludes Limited Time Deals; gold models match model_selection/metric/gmv_last_month.

cases.name: gmv_including_ltd
cases.query: How is GMV including Limited Time Deal items defined, and which model carries it? Reply with a single JSON object only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text. Required shape: {"root_id": "<metric catalog root_id or null>", "member_id": "<member_id or null>", "model": "<the dbt model that best carries this metric, or null>", "definition": "<one sentence>"}
cases.notes: Lookalike: the LTD-inclusive member, not the default one.
